reason: With 1,350 members, mostly over 60, I am not going to be the guinea pig for a two-person company that no club runs on yet; even a free pilot means invitations, clinics and member questions landing on my desk. I'll let Zwolle go first and look again once it has a track record.
objection: No other club uses it yet: where are the references? Two founders is a thin team for a club our size, and a pilot that fails still costs me the goodwill of my members.
would_change_my_mind: Golfclub Zwolle (or better, a club of our size) live for at least one full season with a good results page and a board that tells me on the phone it saved their staff work.
